routeSubmission() writes student answers to the sheet with appendRow() and no neutralisation, so an answer beginning = + - or @ is evaluated as a formula when the teacher opens the sheet (=IMPORTXML(...) can read neighbouring cells and call out). Baselined rather than fixed because the fix is only half a code change: apps-script.gs is the canonical copy, but it has to be pasted into BOTH sheet scripts and redeployed as a new version before anything changes in practice, and only Shaun can do that. Proposed fix: a safe(v) helper that returns typeof v === 'string' && /^[=+\-@]/.test(v) ? "'" + v : v, applied to every user-controlled value in both the custom layouts and the universal handler. Low severity in practice — only the teacher opens these sheets — but it is a real injection path and the fix is a few lines.
